SUMMARY: South Table Mountain MTB with Jennifer
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Bicycle Touring Club  - DBTC
**10:30 AM MTB T2-P2 4-10 miles** (shorter, easier, route is Quarry Trail) Join Jennifer Sax (720-260 8595) for a ride up South Table Mountain. We will meet at the South Table Mountain Park trailhead at 16741 Golden Hills Road. This is the trailhead we usually ride up to from Rimrock Road. Parking is limited but you can park in the nearby neighborhood and join us at 10:30 a.m. We will ride to the Dance Hall and return via the new trail – T-Rex Tooth Trail. If it is a nice day, bring your lunch and lawn chair.
